qs.s: La sorcière a jeté une ___ sur le village.
qs.en: The witch cast a curse on the village.

qs.en: Since that accident, a strange curse of bad luck seems to relentlessly pursue the whole family.

qs.en: Losing his job and his house in the same week, that's a real curse of misfortune.

qs.s: ___ ! J'ai encore raté mon train.
qs.en: Damn it! I missed my train again.

qs.en: Damn it! The store is already closed.
